source: Official names that no game-text corpus in the repository and no Bulbapedia table gives: names that The Pokémon Company prints on its own websites, or that a licensed product prints. This container cannot open those hosts, so each page was read through a search index on the date below. Each row names the page and quotes the text the index returned, and says whether that text is the page title or the index's reading of a list page. npm run i18n:names gives these names `official-usage` provenance. Game text wins: the generator fails when game text or PokéAPI already names the form in that locale.

11105.basis: Overdrive, the look Reshiram, Zekrom and the Kyurem fusions take in battle. Japanese: Bandai Candy's December 2010 product page for 「ポケモンキッズ ベストウイッシュ～レシラム・ゼクロム編～」 (https://www.bandai.co.jp/candy/products/2010/646705.html) heads its lineup with 「ゼクロム オーバードライブ」「レシラム オーバードライブ」, a licensed product. Korean: Pokémon Korea's official site (https://new.pokemonkorea.co.kr/animation/18) says Zekrom enters 오버드라이브 상태 and its tail emits strong electricity. The descriptor is the bare word, without 状態 or 상태, like the English. Not Toxtricity's move Overdrive, which is a different thing that only shares the word.

sources.quote: ゼクロム オーバードライブ / レシラム オーバードライブ
